title: Seahawks expect Sam Darnold to practice "in some capacity" Wednesday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks expect Sam Darnold to practice "in some capacity" Wednesday
sources.description: Word over the weekend was encouraging about quarterback Sam Darnold's recovery from the glute injury that kept him from playing in Week 2 and head coach Mike Macdonald brought more good news on Monday.
